text:
I write

in defense of the kingdom

of man and his justice. I ask

for peace

and the word. I have said

"silence,"

"shadow,"

"void,"

etcetera.

I say

"of man and his justice,"

"Pacific Ocean,"

what they let me.

I ask

for peace and the word.

translation.title: I Ask for Peace and the Word
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Otero's public plea and the restrained inventory of permitted words.
